description.en: Invasion phase: after Ajnadayn "all of Palestine lay open", but towns held out.
description.ar: مرحلة الغزو: بعد أجنادين 'all of Palestine lay open' [كانت فلسطين كلها مفتوحة]، لكن البلدات صمدت.
description.he: שלב הפלישה: לאחר אג׳נדין “all of Palestine lay open” [כל פלשתינה הייתה פתוחה], אך ערים החזיקו מעמד.

sources.quote: All of Palestine then lay open to the invaders.
This battle of Ajnadin took place on Monday twelve days before the end of Jumada I, year 13.
Ecnâdeyn Savaşı ile Filistin ve Suriye’nin kapıları müslümanlara açılmış, iki yıl sonra kazanılan Yermük zaferiyle de bölgenin fethi tamamlanmıştır.

sources.locator: ch. XII "The Conquest of Syria", p. 150 of the scanned printing
sources.quote: resulting in the bloody victory at Ajnadayn on July 30, 634, which laid open before them practically all Palestine.
This battle of Ajnadin took place on Monday twelve days before the end of Jumada I, year 13.

description.en: After the Yarmuk: all but Jerusalem (to 638) and Caesarea (to 640).
description.ar: بعد اليرموك: كل شيء ما عدا القدس (حتى 638) وقيسارية (حتى 640).
description.he: לאחר הירמוך: הכול מלבד ירושלים (עד 638) וקיסריה (עד 640).

sources.quote: The decisive battle that delivered Palestine to the Muslims took place on August 20, 636.
12 Receb 15 (20 Ağustos 636) tarihinde cereyan eden savaşta Bizans ordusu ağır bir yenilgiye uğradı
The battle of al-Yarmuk took place in Rajab, year 15.
Hz. Ömer, Ebû Ubeyde’nin daveti üzerine Câbiye’den Kudüs’e gelerek şehri Patrik Sophronios’tan teslim aldı ve anlaşmayı imzaladı (17/638).
Daha sonra da Askalân ile (19/640) Kaysâriye (20 yılı başları / 640 sonu) başta olmak üzere diğer şehirler ele geçirildi.

sources.locator: ch. XII "The Conquest of Syria", p. 152 of the scanned printing
sources.quote: Months of skirmishing came to a climax on August 20, 636
The battle of al-Yarmuk took place in Rajab, year 15.

sources.locator: ch. XII "The Conquest of Syria", p. 153 of the scanned printing
sources.quote: In the south only Jerusalem and Caesarea, which was strictly Hellenized, held their gates stubbornly closed in the face of the invaders, the former till 638 and the latter till October 640.
The conquest of Jerusalem took place in the year 17.

notes.en: Egypt (incl. Sinai) was conquered from 639/640; Sinai units included schematically.
notes.ar: فُتحت مصر (بما فيها سيناء) منذ 639/640؛ وأُدرجت وحدات سيناء تخطيطيًا.
notes.he: מצרים (כולל סיני) נכבשה מ-639/640; יחידות סיני נכללו באופן סכמטי.

description.en: Whole map area; organized in the junds of Filastin, al-Urdunn and Dimashq.
description.ar: كامل منطقة الخريطة؛ منظمة في أجناد فلسطين والأردن ودمشق.
description.he: כל שטח המפה; מאורגן בג׳ונדים של פלסטין, אל-ארדן ודמשק.

sources.quote: Palestine, and indeed all of Syria, was then in Muslim hands.
Its conquest took place in Shauwal, year 19.
Muâviye b. Ebû Süfyân’a bıraktığı güne kadar (25 Rebîülevvel 41/29 Temmuz 661)

sources.locator: ch. XII "The Conquest of Syria", p. 153 of the scanned printing
sources.quote: In the south only Jerusalem and Caesarea, which was strictly Hellenized, held their gates stubbornly closed in the face of the invaders, the former till 638 and the latter till October 640.
Kaisariyah was taken by storm in the year 19.
According to still other reports, the city was reduced in the early part of the year 20.
a civil war, which ended with the constitution of a new caliphate at Damascus (661), hereditary in the house of the Meccan clan of Umaiyah

notes.en: Caesarea's fall is dated October 640 by Hitti (and Britannica); al-Baladhuri reports AH 19 (640) as the better view but also AH 18 and early AH 20 (641).
notes.ar: يؤرخ حتي (وكذلك بريتانيكا) سقوط قيسارية بتشرين الأول/أكتوبر 640؛ ويروي البلاذري أن سنة 19 هـ (640) هي الأرجح، لكنه يذكر أيضاً سنة 18 هـ وأوائل سنة 20 هـ (641).
notes.he: חיתי (וגם בריטניקה) מתארך את נפילת קיסריה לאוקטובר 640; אל־בלאד'ורי מוסר ששנת 19 להג'רה (640) היא הדעה העדיפה, אך מביא גם את שנת 18 ותחילת שנת 20 להג'רה (641).
